description: Census figure: NCTC 11168 encodes one PF03435 protein, one carboxypolyamine decarboxylase, and no SpeD/SpeE or homospermidine route
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, time
# Re-run the census self-contained and plot it (counts are computed here, not transcribed).
fams=[("PF03435","Sacchrp_dh_NADP (CASDH/CANSDH core)","ASA route"),
      ("PF16653","Sacchrp_dh_C","ASA route"),
      ("PF00278","Orn_DAP_Arg_deC (CASDC / LysA)","ASA route"),
      ("PF02784","Orn/DAP/Arg deC PLP-binding (ADC, LysA)","amine supply"),
      ("PF04371","PAD_porph (agmatine deiminase)","amine supply"),
      ("PF00491","Arginase/agmatinase ureohydrolase","amine supply"),
      ("PF00282","Pyridoxal_deC (group II: DABA-DC)","amine supply"),
      ("PF01564","Spermidine synthase (SpeE)","AdoMet route"),
      ("PF02675","AdoMetDC (SpeD)","AdoMet route"),
      ("PF01916","Deoxyhypusine/homospermidine synthase","alt route")]
cnt=[]
for pf,lab,grp in fams:
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":f'(proteome:UP000000799) AND (xref:pfam-{pf})',"format":"tsv","size":100,
              "fields":"accession,protein_name"},timeout=50)
    ls=r.text.strip().split("\n"); n=0 if len(ls)<2 else len(ls)-1
    cnt.append((lab,grp,n)); time.sleep(0.2)
df=pd.DataFrame(cnt,columns=["family","group","n"])
print(df.to_string(index=False))

col={"ASA route":"#2b6cb0","amine supply":"#2f855a","AdoMet route":"#c05621","alt route":"#805ad5"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,df["n"],color=[col[g] for g in df["group"]],height=0.62)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(df["family"],fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("proteins in C. jejuni NCTC 11168 reference proteome UP000000799")
ax.set_xticks(range(0,4)); ax.set_xlim(0,3.4)
for yi,n in zip(y,df["n"]):
    ax.text(n+0.07,yi,str(n),va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_title("Polyamine enzyme census of NCTC 11168 (UniProt Pfam cross-references)",fontsize=10.5)
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=c) for c in col.values()]
ax.legend(hs,col.keys(),fontsize=8,loc="lower right",frameon=False)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
